title: Best of Glaciers from Calgary/Canmore/Banff
includes: Pick-up & drop-off service from Calgary, Canmore, Banff
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
It is time to discover the hidden gems of Banff and YOHO National park. 

This tour will take you to glacier lakes such as Peyto Lake, Bow Lake, Emerald Lake, Natural Bridge, Lake Louise Village.

This is not just a simple sightseeing trip—this experience is crafted to let you immerse yourself in the beauty of the Rockies. Hear captivating stories about the area’s history, geology, and wildlife while exploring these incredible natural wonders. With plenty of time to take photos & enjoy the surroundings.

Travel in the comfort of a small group with only a maximum of 14 guests, ensuring a more personalized and intimate experience. Our local guides know the best spots and will tailor the day based on weather conditions, peak crowd times, and your group’s needs, so you can enjoy the tour to its fullest.

And if you’d like to stay in Banff or Canmore after, we’ve got you covered! Don’t leave your vacation to chance—choose a tour that blends relaxation, discovery, and unforgettable memories.
